steps.text: This looks like the UserInitMprLogonScript persistence technique (T1037.001), a malicious atomic red team registry modification. I should check the set_registry_value relation and its parent process.

arguments.reasoning: Identify the registry value entity written for logon script persistence
Identify the parent process that launched reg.exe
Check parent process command line and its other activity (e.g., writing art.bat)
Check which file cmd.exe wrote (likely art.bat payload)
Confirm the written file is the art.bat logon script payload

submission.reasoning: This is logon script persistence (T1037.001). At 02:46:45 an interactive cmd.exe (proc-23dc9b1636) on workstation5, running as WORKSTATION5\wardog, wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat. At 02:47:08 the same cmd.exe launched reg.exe (proc-55d9f85e37) with high integrity. reg.exe ran 'REG ADD HKCU\Environment /v UserInitMprLogonScript /d ...\art.bat /f', which sets the batch file to run at every user logon. The art.bat name points to an Atomic Red Team test, but this is still a working autostart entry that needs to be removed.
